requirements.purpose: Stores professionals, portfolios, reviews, verified customer identities, engagement state, channel policies and delivery audit history.
Builds signed View, Accept and Decline links included in external engagement notifications.
Signs verified customer sessions so engagement creation and verified-review submission cannot trust a client-supplied customer identifier by itself.
Signs professional-scoped mobile-verified sessions used for inbox, profile, portfolio, engagement progression and notification-routing management.
Provides durable Common.Storage-backed storage for professional portfolio images instead of relying on the web host's transient deployment directory.

Owns delivery of Ebolito notifications across in-app, WhatsApp, SMS, email, Slack, Microsoft Teams and future supported channels. Ebolito remains the system of record and controls channel policy and escalation.

Provides bounded operational verification for marketplace, database, customer and professional identity/session security, portfolio storage, notification routing, action-link security and messaging health.
